Q4 2026 · NORTH AMERICA

SPIFF rules & eligibility

Instrument incentives and the race to forecast, all in one place.

Instrument SPIFF · how it works

  1. Unlock the SPIFF: North America reaches $8.7M in Q4 instrument revenue.
  2. Meet the product target: Each product qualifies independently when its unit commitment is reached.
  3. Climb the tiers: The highest tier reached sets the rate for every qualifying unit of that product, including units sold before that tier was reached.

Higher tier = higher rate on every qualifying unit, starting with unit 1.

Instrument estimates show the aggregate product payout pool, not an individual rep’s commission. Rep allocation is not specified in the source slide.

Instrument eligibility

  • Units must recognize revenue by December 31, 2026.
  • Natera, replacement, loaner, demo and refurbished units do not count toward placement credit.

Team race · how it works

  1. Race to 100% of Q4 forecast: Each team’s progress is QTD actual revenue divided by its full Q4 revenue forecast. Team names and targets follow the latest published update.
  2. First to forecast: The first team with a confirmed finish earns $1,500 per rep.
  3. Second to forecast: The second team with a confirmed finish earns $750 per rep.
  4. All four teams hit forecast: Every team earns an additional $500 per rep, on top of any podium award.

Live rank shows current forecast attainment. Podium awards follow the confirmed order teams reached forecast—not who has the highest percentage now.

Finish order must be confirmed and unique; a team must have reached forecast to receive a podium place. Awards remain pending while finish order is unresolved. Teams without a forecast await a target.

Regional awards are separate from the instrument payout pool. Amnisure has its own communicated SPIFF.

Calculation & source notes

Race figures come from Qlik QTD actuals and the full Q4 forecast (FC Q4), not budget. Display values are interpreted as USD thousands; rounding may cause small differences in totals. The source date follows the uploaded race as-of date and updates when published data loads.

Tier 1 runs from the commitment through the unit immediately before Tier 2. The source slide’s standalone “$716K” is undefined and is excluded from calculations. Revenue and forecast amounts on the dashboard are in kUSD; 1 kUSD = $1,000.
